_comment: Experimental protocol for the NICEDT-2027 FL-RUL paper. Every run = base config + experiment overrides + one grid point + one seed. Edit here, not in code.

centralized.description: Centralized LSTM on pooled training windows. Fixed budget = num_rounds x local_epochs epochs (100), constant LR, checkpoint selected on the shared validation engines every local_epochs epochs (20 candidates) -- the same policy as FedAvg.

centralized_legacy_es.description: Original repository protocol for reference only: max 50 epochs, early stopping (patience 10) and ReduceLROnPlateau on validation loss, checkpoint selection every epoch. NOT budget-matched to FedAvg.

fedavg_iid.description: FedAvg, K=5, R=20, E=5, IID window-level partition of the same pooled training windows.

local_iid.description: Local-only LSTM: each of the K=5 IID window-level clients trains alone for R x E epochs on its shard; no aggregation.

fedavg_engine.description: FedAvg with whole-engine ownership: the 90 training engines are randomly (seeded) assigned to K=5 clients, 18 engines each.

local_engine.description: Local-only LSTM under whole-engine ownership (each airline trains on its own 18 engines only).

fedavg_dirichlet.description: FedAvg with window-level Dirichlet label skew over 10 RUL bins. Also induces quantity skew (unequal client sizes).

local_dirichlet.description: Local-only counterpart of the Dirichlet partitions (optional; shows how much each skewed client gains from federation).

ablation_fedavg_k1.description: Ablation: FedAvg with a single client holding all training windows (K=1, R=20, E=5). Mathematically centralized training on pooled data with the Adam state reset every 5 epochs and the same selection rule; separates the effect of federation from the effect of FedAvg's per-round optimizer reset.

sweep_rounds.description: Communication-round sweep: K=5, E=5, IID window-level; R varies.

sweep_local_epochs.description: Local-epoch sweep: K=5, R=20, IID window-level; E varies.

sweep_clients.description: Client-count sweep: R=20, E=5, IID window-level. Total training data FIXED (all 90 training engines' windows); per-client data shrinks as K grows.

sweep_clients_engine.description: Client-count sweep under whole-engine ownership (window-level vs whole-engine at each K). Total training data fixed.
